svg.title: Measured RX Digital release after the last accepted-signal refresh
svg.desc: Two panels show RECENT and BEEP countdown samples decoded from live SRAM. Eight new BEEP activations follow the last RECENT refresh. Final BEEP clearing follows that refresh by 0.816 to 0.865 seconds. Zero is the estimated last refresh, not the TX Pause event. Reads are sequential and non-atomic.

g.text: Digital release: eight further BEEP activations
Measured live SRAM | 20 September 2026 | Median sample spacing: 17.054 ms
Sample + host read window; connecting lines guide the eye
Time relative to estimated last accepted-signal refresh (seconds)
Zero = midpoint of the last RECENT-refresh bracket. This is not a timestamp of the TX Pause button.
Sequential live reads are non-atomic. Whiskers show individual read windows; the shared zero-time uncertainty is shaded.
BEEP is a software countdown, not a direct speaker/PWM measurement. Source: digital-pause-20260920-221932.jsonl
